listing.name: Virtua Cop — virtuacop (sp00nznet)
listing.summary: Upstream reaches boot, attract, coin/start and a playable first-person stage; stage completion not verified and sound wholly unimplemented. Main game CPU is native C; coprocessor emulation must be disclosed. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own vcop/vcopa ROM set including CPU-board math tables opr-14742a.45 and opr-14743a.46. rom_loader produces program/data/polygon/texture/coproc images; generated game C is local and not distributed.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Local source route: rom_loader.py extracts ROM images, i960_lifter.py generates game C, CMake builds vcop.exe using SDL2/vcpkg. Runtime loads the resulting ROM image directory. No ready player archive is established by this README.

warnings: Upstream reaches boot, attract, coin/start and a playable first-person stage; stage completion not verified and sound wholly unimplemented. Main game CPU is native C; coprocessor emulation must be disclosed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
